name: RBF Encoding of Volume Data
definition: A method for encoding volumetric scalar data using a compact set of Radial Basis Functions (RBFs) to eliminate the need for large computational grids and reduce CPU-to-GPU data transfer bottlenecks.
summary: RBF Encoding of Volume Data uses compact Radial Basis Functions to eliminate large grids and reduce data transfer, differing from other methods by mandating per-fragment procedural reconstruction.
